**DUKE OF ASHGROVE (Cold):**
Start: (00:03.20) | End: (00:06.00)

**COUNTESS VALE (Screaming):**
Start: (00:10.20) | End: (00:12.40)

Start: (00:12.60) | End: (00:15.00)

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:19.00) | End: (00:23.00)

**MARA (Screaming):**
Start: (00:23.20) | End: (00:26.80)
